## Design constraints this must respect

- [ ] It is **configurable**, with a default that preserves current behaviour
- [ ] It does not hardcode an organisation, hostname, provider, or model identifier
- [ ] It does not make a previously optional service mandatory
- [ ] If it touches personal data, prompts, or retention, that is called out above
